dedupe_keys.name: first validation of high resolution satellite derived methane emissions from an active gas leak in the uk

description: Royal Holloway researchers and collaborators publish satellite methane-plume rasters and mobile observations from an active gas leak near Cheltenham, United Kingdom. The February 2024 Zenodo release is free under CC BY 4.0. Five GeoTIFF filenames identify GHGSat observations from March to June 2023. The mobile-survey README documents one-hertz location and gas measurements, with measured or model-derived wind information for plume analysis. These observations can calibrate leak-dispersion, emissions and detection components in gas-infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the experiment. The landing page gives the second survey as 12 June, whereas its filename and README say 22 June; this conflict is retained. The README also says that the June survey has no wind data because Gaussian plume modelling was not performed for it. Raster resolution, gas units, uncertainty and correspondence between ground and satellite acquisition times require further checking. No measurement files were opened.
